remarks: Fabulous End-Unit Townhouse in Prime New Canaan Location Move right into this sun-filled, end-unit townhouse just a short stroll from the heart of New Canaan Village! Enjoy easy access to town, train, award-winning schools, top restaurants, and the stunning new state-of-the-art library.  The main level boasts a spacious dining room perfect for entertaining, a newly updated kitchen with modern appliances, and an inviting living room with built-in bookshelves and sliders that open to a large deck overlooking a lush lawn and garden.  Upstairs, you'll find three generously sized bedrooms and two full bathrooms. The fully finished lower level offers a bright playroom with garden views, a fourth bedroom, full bath, laundry room, and ample storage.  Low-maintenance living at its best - just moments from everything and an easy commute to NYC!
